intent: A two-part storage box: an open-top rectangular body with thin perimeter walls on a solid floor, and a separate lid carrying an inner locating lip that seats inside the body rim as a loose fit. Each part prints flat.

parts.description: Open-top box body, 70x50x25 mm outer, 2 mm walls
parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (passive enclosure shell, no declared load)

interfaces.description: Lip locates in the body rim

parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (locating lip is a sliding fit, no sustained load)
